grades.quote: The P bit refers to whether a page table entry on the TLB table entry is present. A page table entry is present even if it is invalid ( `V=0` ).
grades.reason: Distinguishes a TLB entry being present (E/P) from the page being valid (V). An entry can exist in the TLB yet be invalid (V=0), so presence in the TLB and mapping validity are separate concepts. It does not explicitly cover the missing-entry case or refill versus invalid-page handling.

grades.quote: When a TLB refill exception is triggered, the [VALEN-1:13] bits of the virtual address that triggered the exception are recorded here.
grades.reason: Describes the TLB refill exception register, which is used when a TLB lookup misses. It does not address whether a missing entry differs from an invalid mapping, so it is only auxiliary context.
